description:
Cross-platform encrypted email client

Aster Mail is a cross-platform, end-to-end encrypted email client built for Aster Privacy. Features quantum-safe encryption and zero-knowledge architecture.
> [!NOTE]
> These files are for new installations. If Aster Mail is already installed, it updates automatically.

## Fixed

• Exporting a large mailbox now finishes. Large exports used to fail near the end and leave a 0-byte zip file behind.
• Aster Mail writes the export to disk as it goes, so your mailbox no longer has to fit in memory to export it.
• Archives larger than 4 GB are written in the zip64 format, so your archive tool can open them.
• If an export stops part way, Aster Mail keeps what it already wrote instead of discarding the file.
• When your mailbox is too large for the server to count, the progress display shows how many messages it has exported so far.
